extDescription.message: Self-hosted, privacy-first browser synchronization for Helium and other Chromium browsers.

statusErr_rate_limited.message: Too many requests. Sync will retry shortly.

statusErr_unauthorized.message: The server rejected this device's sign-in.

statusErr_busy.message: The server is busy. Sync will retry shortly.

statusErr_internal_error.message: The server hit an error. Sync will retry shortly.

setup_subtitle.message: Sign in with your HelixSync account to start syncing.

setup_serverUrlFirst.message: Enter a valid Server URL first.

setup_insecureUrl.message: The Server URL must use https:// (http:// is only allowed for localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1]).

setup_permissionDenied.message: Permission to contact the server was not granted.

setup_emailAndName.message: Enter your email and a device name first.

setup_permissionLastDevice.message: Permission wasn't granted last time — click "Log in with device instead" to try again.

setup_permissionLastConnect.message: Permission wasn't granted last time — click Connect to try again.

devicewait_body.message: Open HelixSync on a browser that's already connected to this account and approve the request there. Approve it only if that browser shows this phrase:

devicewait_keyMismatch.message: The key check didn't match, so the approval was discarded.

devicewait_expired.message: The sign-in request expired. Start a new one.

devicewait_deviceLimit.message: This account has the maximum number of devices. Revoke one on the dashboard and this browser will connect.

keycheck_body.message: The approving browser shows a key check phrase on its sign-in request. Continue only if it matches:

statusview_olderHistoryTitle.message: Import this browser's history older than the previous retention window

statusview_importStarted.message: Importing older history in the background.

auth_resetWarningCompletes.message: WARNING: this lets someone set a new password for your account. Approve only if YOU asked to reset your password. {approvals} of 2 approvals so far; approving now completes it and hands your encryption key to that page.

auth_resetWarningSecond.message: WARNING: this lets someone set a new password for your account. Approve only if YOU asked to reset your password. {approvals} of 2 approvals so far; a second browser must also approve.

auth_webConsequence.message: Approving signs that browser in to your dashboard.

auth_deviceConsequence.message: Approving gives that browser your encryption key and all your synced data.

auth_approveOnlyIf.message: Approve only if the other screen shows:

auth_keyCheckReset.message: After you approve, the reset page asks you to confirm this key check phrase:

auth_keyCheckDevice.message: After you approve, the new browser asks you to confirm this key check phrase:

auth_alreadyAnswered.message: This request was already answered or has expired.

auth_resetChanged.message: This reset changed (this browser already approved, or another one did first). Reopen the popup.

settings_restorePointsHelp.message: Daily and safety copies of your bookmarks. Manual ones are always available.

settings_disconnectConfirm.message: Disconnect this device? It will be removed from your account's device list, and you can reconnect any time by signing in again.

settings_tabGroupsNeedPermission.message: Tab groups need permission in this browser: press Save to allow it.

settings_tabGroupsDenied.message: Tab group sync needs the tab groups permission. Allow it, or turn Tab Groups off.

rp_subtitle.message: Saved copies of your bookmarks. Roll back to one if something goes wrong.

rp_unavailable.message: Restore points are not available: this server doesn't support them, or bookmark sync is off or still importing.

rp_deleteConfirm.message: Delete the restore point from {date}? This can't be undone.

rp_modeMerge.message: Merge: bring back what's missing, undo edits. Deletes nothing.

rp_modeExact.message: Exact: also remove bookmarks that aren't in this point.

rp_nothingToDo.message: Nothing to do: your bookmarks already match this restore point.

rp_confirmExactAll.message: Restore all your bookmarks exactly? Bookmarks added after {date} will be removed from every device. A copy of your current bookmarks is saved first.

rp_confirmExactFolder.message: Restore the folder "{name}" exactly? Bookmarks added after {date} will be removed from every device. A copy of your current bookmarks is saved first.

rp_confirmMergeAll.message: Restore all your bookmarks from {date}? A copy of your current bookmarks is saved first.

rp_confirmMergeFolder.message: Restore the folder "{name}" from {date}? A copy of your current bookmarks is saved first.

rp_noFolders.message: This restore point has no folders.

rp_prepare.message: Saving a copy of your bookmarks and getting ready…

rp_err_bookmarksNotReady.message: Bookmarks are still being prepared for sync. Try again in a moment.

rp_err_limit.message: No room for a new restore point: the rest are pinned. Unpin or delete one first.

rp_err_pinLimit.message: Too many pinned restore points. Unpin one first.

rp_err_unreadable.message: This restore point can't be read, so it was not applied.

rp_err_updateNeeded.message: Update the HelixSync extension to use this restore point.

rp_err_reauth.message: Sign in again to use restore points.

rp_err_syncFailed.message: Could not sync before restoring. Check your connection and try again.

rp_err_preRestoreFailed.message: Could not save a copy of your bookmarks first, so nothing was restored.

rp_err_unavailable.message: This server does not support restore points.

sendtab_notConnected.message: Connect this browser to your account first.

sendtab_unsupported.message: This server does not support sending tabs.

sendtab_badUrl.message: Only web pages (http or https) can be sent.

sendtab_tooLarge.message: This address is too long to send.

sendtab_deviceGone.message: That device is no longer available.

sendtab_rateLimited.message: Too many tabs sent. Try again in a minute.

settings_sendTabHelp.message: Show a notification when a tab is sent or arrives. Needs the browser's notifications permission.

settings_sendTabDenied.message: The notifications permission was not granted.
